People's Majlis

People's Majlis Committee Minutes

1st Meeting of the Environment and Climate Change Committee

14 April 2026

Venue: People's Majlis [unclear] (Committee Room 6)
Start time: 11:05

{Presiding: Committee Chair; Member for South Maafannu constituency Abdulla Rifau}

Chair speaking:
In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. I welcome you to the first meeting this term of the People's Majlis Environment and Climate Change Committee. This meeting is being held in Committee Room 6. Today's date is 14 April 2026, Tuesday. The time is 11:05. Today we have put this sitting on the agenda to discuss two important matters. In connection with an issue submitted to this committee by a member of the public, it was decided earlier to refer it to two relevant institutions to seek their views on the matter. Replies have now been received from both institutions: the Economic Ministry and the Environment Ministry. The second matter is that, as I took the initiative on behalf of the committee to request a meeting with the Indian High Commissioner, he has given us time tomorrow. So, to discuss that matter. So, first we will take up; before starting, I will read out the names of the members present at this time. I, Member for South Maafannu constituency Abdulla Rifau; Member for Mulaku constituency Ibrahim Naufal; Member for Central Hulhumale' constituency Abdulla Shazeem; Member for West Maafannu constituency Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim; Member for Mathiveri constituency Hassan Zareer; Member for Hithaadhoo constituency Mohamed Siruhaan; Member for South Thinadhoo constituency Mohamed Alsan; Member for Vilifushi constituency Hassan Waheed are present at this time. So, what you now see on the screen is the reply to the letter we sent from our side to the Ministry of Tourism, the Ministry of Tourism and Environment. So, I give the floor to committee members to put forward any views they have regarding these two letters. Member for West Maafannu constituency Musthafa.

Member for West Maafannu constituency Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim speaking:
Thank you, Chair. What I notice, looking at the two letters sent to the two institutions, is that each party speaks for its own protection and safety. So, the Environment Ministry's letter is very much based on the environment and says that it cannot be done, and the Economic Ministry defends the rights of businesspeople and says that doing it is something it supports

is in fact what was noted. So, what we got were two opinions from two sides. So, what I see is that we will have to do further work within the Majlis, within the committee. Instead of sending letters, what comes to my mind now is that we actually need to talk with the members of the Business Council as well. I actually propose that we need to meet and talk with them. That is because what the Business Council members have noted is talk in favour of the rights of businesspeople. So, along with that, also to meet separately with the people from the Environment [Ministry]. So, we carry these two meetings forward side by side. And in addition to this, I think the Health Ministry should also be involved at this time, you know. That is because bottles, mostly items below 500 ml, are things connected to health, so to take that forward as well. So, what I note here is that we now need to meet with these three parties as well. That is, to meet separately with the Business Council members, the Environment Ministry and the Health Ministry officials, and to do more work to find a solution to this. That is, two opinions came from two sides. So, we will work based on this. So, I will put forward this proposal. If this is done within a sub-committee, then a working group actually has to be formed, and a number of tasks have to be carried out. So, I would also like to say that I propose forming a sub-committee to take the work forward. Thank you.

Chair speaking:
Member for Mulaku constituency Ibrahim Naufal.

Member for Mulaku constituency Ibrahim Naufal speaking:
Yes! I second the proposal put forward by the Member for West Maafannu constituency Musthafa Ibrahim.

Chair speaking:
As there are no further proposals, since the proposal just put forward by the Member for West Maafannu constituency, to form a sub-committee to study this matter further, has been seconded, I put it to a vote. (Voting) Thank you. The proposal has passed by a majority, unanimously, of all members present. So, I think we should form a sub-committee of three members. It would be good to first know who would like to volunteer to take part in the sub-committee. Member for West Maafannu constituency Musthafa.

Member for West Maafannu constituency Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim speaking:
One of the reasons I actually proposed a sub-committee is that, even if the whole committee meets with these three parties, the actual paperwork will still come. The work of further studying and compiling a paper that needs to be compiled will also come in doing that work. And if we proceed by meeting further with other groups, doing that work is in reality the work of that sub-committee. Otherwise, compiling a single report or carrying out a study with the whole committee will not turn out to be that easy, when everyone studies it together. So, I fully support, as the Chair just proposed, completing that paperwork, and actually doing the study, under the oversight of three members. So, that will be the mandate of that sub-committee. The mandate of the sub-committee will actually be to compile a report based on the study carried out on this matter. So, I wanted to say that. And I also want to say that I will take the lead in this, you know. Thank you very much.

Chair speaking:
Thank you. So, now; Member for Mathiveri constituency Hassan Zareer.

Member for Mathiveri constituency Hassan Zareer speaking:

Yes! Thank you. The names I wish to propose for the sub-committee we just talked about are Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim. Member, then Mohamed Niushad and the committee Chair Abdulla Rifau.

Member for Hithaadhoo constituency Mohamed Siruhaan speaking:
I second the proposal put forward by the honourable Member for Mathiveri constituency.

Chair speaking:
Member for Hithaadhoo constituency Mohamed Siruhaan.

Member for Hithaadhoo constituency Mohamed Siruhaan speaking:
I second the proposal put forward by the honourable Member for Mathiveri constituency Hassan Zareer.

Chair speaking:
The names of three members have now been proposed to the committee and seconded. So, I put this proposal to a vote. (Voting). Thank you very much. With the unanimous agreement of all members present at this time, the committee has now been formed. So, essentially, as noted in the discussion just now, the main mandate of the committee is to carry forward studies on this matter. Then, for meetings held with important parties, those matters are to be planned in a way that the whole committee can be invited. Then, at the committee's meeting, a leadership of the committee can be set up and a way to carry forward the committee's work can be planned. Then, along with that, to discuss another very important matter: in order to strengthen our committee's work further and to increase the capacity of committee members, to seek assistance for that, we have requested a meeting with the Indian High Commission to look at what ways there are to receive assistance from the Indian High Commission. Following our request, a meeting with the Indian High Commissioner has now been

scheduled for tomorrow, 15 April 2026, at 9:30. So, I very much request that all members attend this meeting, and, if you have any views, look at what ways there are for the two sides to work together, and come prepared with the matters you would like to request from the Indian High Commission or the Government of India, and then I very much request that all members attend on time; also, an official from the Foreign Ministry will take part in this meeting. And an official from this Majlis's Foreign Committee will also take part. We have very high hopes that after this meeting very good things will happen for us. So, I request that those who could not take part in today's meeting also come tomorrow. Then Asad has informed us that he is running a little late because of the rain. Thank you. Then, after closing our committee for today, our very important committee meeting, as I just noted, will begin tomorrow morning at 9:30. So, I request all members to come 5 minutes early. Then, since the committee has been scheduled today, the Secretariat will inform all members of the committee room and other details at some time today. Thank you very much.
